standard_bios.medium_bio_500: Gary Pearce is the lead physical security and telecoms infrastructure engineer at ADI Communications (07860 244 274). With 25+ years hands-on experience and £10M Public Liability insurance, Gary delivers forensic-grade installations across Yorkshire and Lancashire: SpaceX Starlink non-drill chimney mounts, Grade 2 Ajax smart security, Hikvision ColorVu 4K CCTV, external UV-resistant Cat6 data runs, and Corefix TV wall mounting.
standard_bios.long_bio_markdown:
# Gary Pearce — Lead Physical Security & Telecoms Infrastructure Engineer
**Founder, ADI Communications** • Direct Mobile: `07860 244 274` • West Yorkshire, UK

With over 25 years of continuous hands-on trade craftsmanship, Gary Pearce designs and installs high-reliability electronic security, satellite broadband, and domestic data infrastructure across Yorkshire, Lancashire, and Greater Manchester.

### Core Engineering Disciplines:
* **SpaceX Starlink Satellite Rigging**: 90mph Pennine gale-rated non-drill chimney lashing cradles, gable apex standoffs, and whole-home Wi-Fi 7 router bypass integration.
* **Intruder Alarms & Physical Security**: Grade 2/3 BS EN 50131 Ajax Jeweller wireless security systems, dual-SIM cellular failover, and MotionCam outdoor photo-on-demand detection.
* **Commercial & Domestic 4K CCTV**: Hikvision ColorVu low-light aperture cameras, 16MP panoramic dual-lens systems, unjammable hardwired PoE infrastructure, and Police evidence formatting.
* **Structured Data Cabling & Networking**: External UV-rated Cat6 cavity wall drops with downward drip loops, 10-inch SOHO patch cabinets, Fluke DSX-8000 certification, and 5GHz/60GHz gigabit garden office wireless bridges.
* **Architectural TV Wall Mounting**: Corefix dot-and-dab masonry anchoring, Samsung The Frame flush mounting, and thermal safety calculation above wood-burning fireplaces.

### Verified Credentials:
* £10,000,000 Public Liability Insurance Coverage
* NVQ Level 1–4 Data Cabling, Fibre Optics & Electrical Standards
* CAI-Benchmarked Materials & High-Screening WF100 Coaxial Cable
* 9.98 / 10 Customer Rating across 84+ Verified Client Reviews
